face_block_triangle.name: Triangle face / the building block in the hand
face_block_triangle.description: One 32 cm triangle face. Taken from the hanging box at a building table it is the hand's selected item (the wrist clock shows it); a frame on the table takes one face for each trigger. Not placed in maps.
